findings.detail: Private credit SOI rows carry Reference Rate and Spread values, but the extracted holdings rows have blank interest_rate, triggering X02.

rationale: Class 1 row/field check: X02 flags PRIVATE_CREDIT rows with blank interest_rate and no basis_spread. The source SOI has an explicit Reference Rate and Spread column, and representative flagged instruments show populated rate/spread cells, for example AB Centers DDTL and revolver at S + 5.25 %, Harvey Tool DDTL at S + 5.25 %, and Netwrix DDTL at S + 4.75 %. The stored observed value is blank, so the flag is a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm. No aggregate anchor is needed for this row-level rate field defect.
